name: Camp KidZone
description_short: A city run day camp for children entering grades 1 to 4 at Look Memorial Park in Florence, Northampton. Days mix sports, crafts and games around a weekly theme, with swimming at the JFK Middle School pool or Musante Beach, a weekly field trip and children's shows at the park's Pines Theater. Weekly sessions, 8:30 am to 4:30 pm.
refund_policy_summary: A $25 deposit per session is non-refundable. Refund requests must be made in writing by May 29, 2026; no refunds after that date, and a $10 processing fee applies.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim Monday, Tuesday and Thursday at the Aquatic and Family Center at JFK Middle School after a swim check by a lifeguard, and Friday afternoons at Musante Beach in Leeds.
notes: Prices shown are non-resident rates; Northampton, Florence and Leeds residents pay $10 less ($185 for 4 day weeks, $225 for 5 day weeks). Extended day 7:45 am to 5:15 pm costs $30 to $35 a week. Field trips and a T-shirt are included. A $20 Look Park summer sticker is needed for drop off and pick up. Financial aid is for Northampton, Florence and Leeds residents only.
